title: Short-End Treasuries Become Popular Bet on Fed Inflation Win
summary:
Investors in the US Treasury market are shifting their focus to owning shorter-dated government bonds, a bet that the Federal Reserve will eventually emerge victorious in its fight against inflation. 
Gennadiy Goldberg, Head of US Rates Strategy at TD Securities, discusses how the current rate hiking cycle might evolve and where the 10-year could finish the year. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Alibaba Higher on Chip News; On Holdings Football Move | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Alibaba (BABA) shares are higher this morning after the company rolled out what it calls China’s most powerful AI chip and announced plans to expand data center capacity in the coming years.
- ON Holdings (ONON) is getting a boost as it expects sales growth in the high teens over the next few years as it moves into sports including golf and football.
- Viking Therapeutics (VKTX) shares surged after the biotech released data from its VK2735-102 maintenance study showing VK2735, its experimental obesity drug, maintained up to 97% of weight loss versus 61% for placebo when subjects switched to every-other-week dosing. Leerink analysts said the “stellar” data strengthens the drug’s competitive profile. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Goldman's Snider Expects Double-Digit S&P Earnings Growth
summary: Goldman Sachs Chief US Equity Strategist Ben Snider says investors should not be anxious. He expects S&P 500 companies to report double-digit earnings growth starting next week. He also talks about the AI trade on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
